text: From 1,000 applicants to the top 5 AI builders. How do you identify the people who can actually deliver?
AI helps candidates build faster and deliver impressive results. But where's the evidence behind their work — their AI conversations, code changes, decisions, and actual contributions?

Meet VibeLevel Screening, an AI-era assessment platform that helps recruiters evaluate technical and non-technical talent with evidence-backed insights into how candidates think, work with AI, and contribute.
Recruiters get a detailed candidate report with performance scores, AI collaboration insights, Code Review, Video Q&A, and an Interview Guide to explore candidate strengths and gaps.
With Review Session, recruiters can explore AI conversations, code changes, and outputs. See what candidates did well, where they fell short, and the evidence behind every finding.
Candidates tackle realistic, role-specific challenges in a dedicated workspace, with AI coding tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot integrated for technical assessments.
VibeLevel evaluates candidates across four dimensions: Core Skills, Working with AI, Ownership, and Human Contribution. Understand what they bring beyond the final output.
Go deeper with a short AI-led interview that reveals their thinking and reasoning.
VibeLevel Screening. Understand the person behind the performance.
